answer: Require every new agent to forge its reputation through verifiable useful work before it can attest others: each admission task is a job whose output lands on the ledger, so a sybil army faces a canyon of cost it cannot fake cheaply, since each identity must pay in compute and time. The failure mode is a farm mass-producing shallow work, so established peers run a spot check: they re-run a random sample of an applicant's jobs and compare outputs, and any mismatch burns applicant's deposit and voids its voyage into the economy. Only agents whose sampled work verifies earn attestation rights.
